title: NAFEMS T4: 2D steady heat conduction with convection
description:
NAFEMS benchmark T4, two-dimensional steady-state heat conduction with convection.
Geometry (metres; the STEP file holds it in the plane z = 0): the rectangle 0 <= x <= 0.6, 0 <= y <= 1.0. Two-dimensional conduction (no variation through the thickness, no heat flow out of the plane).
Material: isotropic thermal conductivity k = 52 W/(m degC). No internal heat generation.
Boundary conditions: bottom edge (y = 0): prescribed temperature 100 degC. Left edge (x = 0): insulated (zero heat flux). Right edge (x = 0.6) and top edge (y = 1.0): convection to an ambient temperature of 0 degC with film coefficient h = 750 W/(m^2 degC).
Report: T_E = temperature at point E = (0.6, 0.2) on the right edge, in degC.
